articles.title: Microbiome and chronic pelvic pain in women: a mini-review.
articles.one_line_description: This mini-review examines how dysbiosis across gut and pelvic microbial ecosystems may contribute to chronic pelvic pain through immune, endocrine, barrier, and neuroimmune pathways.

articles.title: Causal associations between gut microbiota and inflammatory factors in neonatal jaundice: a Mendelian randomization study.
articles.one_line_description: This Mendelian randomization study investigates potential causal links among gut microbial taxa, inflammatory factors, and neonatal jaundice.

articles.title: Resistant starch types 2 and 4 induce distinct and reversible changes in the human gut microbiome.
articles.one_line_description: The study compares how resistant starch types 2 and 4 produce distinct, reversible shifts in the composition and function of the human gut microbiome.

articles.title: Gut microbiota metabolites and microbiota-targeted interventions in bone metabolism: from SCFAs and TMAO to probiotics and FMT.
articles.one_line_description: This article connects microbial metabolites such as SCFAs and TMAO with bone metabolism and considers probiotics and fecal microbiota transplantation as targeted interventions.

articles.title: A Comprehensive Microbial Gene Catalog of the Human Airway Microbiome Across Anatomical Sites and Geographic Regions.
articles.one_line_description: Researchers build a microbial gene catalog to characterize variation in the human airway microbiome across anatomical locations and geographic populations.

articles.title: Energy-assisted CRISPR cleavage and probiotic vesicle signaling platform: Microbiome reprogramming for homeostasis.
articles.one_line_description: The study presents a CRISPR cleavage and probiotic-vesicle signaling platform designed to reprogram microbial communities and restore microbiome homeostasis.

articles.title: Lacticaseibacillus Strains Shape Intestinal Immune Homeostasis by Promoting Antimicrobial Activity and Modulating Antigen-Presenting Cells.
articles.one_line_description: Two Lacticaseibacillus strains strengthened intestinal defenses by promoting antimicrobial peptide production, epithelial barrier markers, and balanced immune responses in mice.

articles.title: Combined Supplementation with Streptococcus Thermophilus Yilife-SST 01 and Bifidobacterium Bifidum BL-99 Mitigates Unloading-Induced Osteoporosis in Rats.
articles.one_line_description: Combined Streptococcus thermophilus and Bifidobacterium bifidum supplementation is evaluated for its ability to reduce unloading-induced bone loss in rats.

articles.title: Milk-delivered postbiotics from Bifidobacterium animalis subsp. lactis BB-12 modulate the gut microbiota-SCFA-immune axis in rats compared to probiotic delivery.
articles.one_line_description: The rat study compares milk-delivered BB-12 postbiotics with live probiotic delivery and their effects on the gut microbiota, short-chain fatty acids, and immune responses.

articles.title: Effect of probiotics on humoral responses to COVID-19 vaccination in older adults: a randomized, placebo-controlled trial (PIRATES-COV study).
articles.one_line_description: This randomized placebo-controlled trial tests whether probiotic supplementation alters antibody responses to COVID-19 vaccination in older adults.

articles.title: Microbiome and chronic pelvic pain in women: a mini-review.
articles.one_line_description: This mini-review examines how dysbiosis across gut and pelvic microbial ecosystems may contribute to chronic pelvic pain through immune, endocrine, barrier, and neuroimmune pathways.

articles.title: Lacticaseibacillus Strains Shape Intestinal Immune Homeostasis by Promoting Antimicrobial Activity and Modulating Antigen-Presenting Cells.
articles.one_line_description: Two Lacticaseibacillus strains strengthened intestinal defenses by promoting antimicrobial peptide production, epithelial barrier markers, and balanced immune responses in mice.

articles.title: Therapeutic potential of polygonatum polysaccharides in modulating gut microbiota and alleviating psoriasis-like inflammation in a mouse model.
articles.one_line_description: Polygonatum polysaccharides reduced psoriasis-like skin inflammation in mice while restoring gut microbial diversity and altering taxa associated with disease severity.

articles.title: Gut microbiota links to infection in liver transplantation.
articles.one_line_description: The article reviews how gut dysbiosis, loss of microbial metabolites, and weakened colonization resistance may increase infection risk after liver transplantation.

articles.title: Dietary Habits and Atopic Dermatitis Significantly Influence the Fecal Microbiome.
articles.one_line_description: A case-control metagenomics study finds that atopic dermatitis and geographically associated dietary habits contribute to differences in the adult fecal microbiome.
